notes.title: Important updates!
notes.content:
An update has been downloaded for the game that fixes the following issues: 
1. In the main menu has never shown in the level information that is made 5/5 puzzles. 
2. The game did not save information about the 5th game mode.
3. Now during the game, when you select the game mode - it will be seen in which mode you have already collected the puzzle (round piece will be slightly green)
